title: Isomorphism of the degree-zero cycle factor
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian sheaf on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $s:G[0]\to I^\bullet$ a quasi-isomorphism with $I^\bullet$ K-injective [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions]. Write $\Gamma(T,-)$ for global sections and $Z^0$ for the kernel of the degree-zero differential. If $z:\Gamma(T,G)\to Z^0(\Gamma(T,I^\bullet))$ satisfies $i\circ z=\Gamma(T,s^0)$, where $i$ is the inclusion of cycles, then $\pi\circ z:\Gamma(T,G)\to H^0(\Gamma(T,I^\bullet))$ is an isomorphism, where $\pi$ is the homology projection [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

source.place: Lemma Tag 05TD, proof of (3), with a nonnegative injective resolution (Tag 013K) and transport by a homotopy equivalence to the given K-injective resolution.

proof.text: Choose a bounded-below injective resolution of G and use the left-exact degree-zero comparison to identify its sections with degree-zero homology.
Use resolution independence and homotopy naturality to transport the isomorphism to the given K-injective resolution; the equality hz identifies the transported augmentation with z ≫ homologyπ.
